rows.corpus_definition: The way someone or something is at a particular time.
rows.example_en: The house was in a bad state.

rows.corpus_definition: To go to bed later than usual.
rows.example_en: I stayed up all night working.

rows.corpus_definition: Having a sharp angle, making it hard to go up or down.
rows.example_en: The path to the top was very steep.

rows.corpus_definition: to cause a sharp burning pain; a wound from an insect's needle
rows.example_en: A bee stung him on the arm.

rows.corpus_definition: Having very bad weather with strong wind and rain.
rows.example_en: It was a very stormy night yesterday.

rows.corpus_definition: The quality of being physically powerful or not breaking easily.
rows.example_en: The rope has enough strength to hold him.

rows.corpus_definition: A feeling of worry caused by difficult situations.
rows.example_en: Too much work causes a lot of stress.

rows.corpus_definition: A worried feeling caused by difficult situations in your life.
rows.example_en: Too much work can cause a lot of stress.

rows.corpus_definition: to make something longer or wider by pulling it
rows.example_en: This fabric will stretch after you wash it.

rows.corpus_definition: a long thin piece cut from something; to remove a covering
rows.example_en: He stripped the old paint off the wooden door.

rows.corpus_definition: having lines of color on it
rows.example_en: He wore a striped tie with his suit.
